retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts: Quick scene changes every 1-2 seconds to maintain visual interest.
Open Loops: Hint at information coming later in the Short to build suspense.
Dynamic Text/Graphics: Animated captions and on-screen elements that reinforce key points.
Sound Design: Use trendy sounds, sudden sound effects, and music drops to punctuate moments.
Pattern Interrupts: Sudden changes in music, visual style, or speaker delivery to re-engage attention.
Value Density: Pack as much useful or entertaining information into each second as possible.
